verdict.rationale: Extend has a single file-upload endpoint whose files feed parsing, extraction, and workflows. It automatically converts Word and PowerPoint uploads to PDF, so DOCX/PPTX need no per-format plumbing, and a dedicated Supported File Types page exists. However, the pack only shows that page's title, not which formats it lists, so most of the requested mix is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of XLSX, HTML, standalone image, and email (EML/MSG) support; the content of the supported-file-types list; independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling.
